01

Set the design search

1,764 combinations. Choose a winner for efficiency, mass, no-load current or tank volume.

Volts-per-turn factor K
Flux density T
Current density A/mm²
Window ratio H/W
Search resolution Number of values, including endpoints

One value fixes that variable at its minimum. The total search is capped at 5,000 combinations. H/W is L/(D−d), the ratio used in the core-type textbook program.

Choose by objective

Every feasible variant competes for the four textbook criteria. A balanced Pareto choice is also available.

Engineering mode applies the project's thermal, fit, current-density, mass and tank limits, then offers a balanced Pareto choice. Textbook mode mirrors the lecturer's core-type loop: L/(D−d), I0/I2, 7 mm slack and 98.5% efficiency, with four independent winners.

02

Set feasibility limits

A feasible design passes every selected limit. The four textbook winners are selected from that feasible set; diagnostic results remain available if no variant passes.

Physical-fit guardrails Relaxed project defaults

Zero clearance or slack means components may touch but cannot overlap. The stricter 7 mm and 15 mm academic checks remain visible in the engineering review.
